items.text: Softcore servers now limit the number of placed Tool Cupboards to three; you’ll receive an icon and toast notification when the limit is reached.
Biofuel generators only consume electricity while actively producing fuel, eliminating idle power drain.
Livestock no longer lose age progress when calves mature, fixing incorrect age regression.
Leash break distance increased from 7 m to 15 m, and livestock now display familiarity and gender by default.
Selling bought or found animals to the livestock vendor now incurs a higher penalty, increased from 0.2 to 0.85.
Introduced a revamped character creator layout and added an underwear customization category, expanding player appearance options.

2026-10-05.summary:
### Base Building
- Softcore servers now limit the number of placed Tool Cupboards to three; you’ll receive an icon and toast notification when the limit is reached.

### Power & Utilities
- Biofuel generators only consume electricity while actively producing fuel, eliminating idle power drain.

### Livestock & Economy
- Livestock no longer lose age progress when calves mature, fixing incorrect age regression.
- Leash break distance increased from 7 m to 15 m, and livestock now display familiarity and gender by default.
- Selling bought or found animals to the livestock vendor now incurs a higher penalty, increased from 0.2 to 0.85.

### Quality of Life
- Introduced a revamped character creator layout and added an underwear customization category, expanding player appearance options.

items.text: Fixed death screen on first softcore join; players now spawn directly at the beach.
Research tables can now be used to research Animal Fence and Gate.
Milk can be stacked when the skim timer is under 1 minute, and skimming works even if food spoiling is disabled.
Scrap helicopter dismount points adjusted to avoid always ejecting players from the front.

2026-10-04.summary:
### Softcore Mode
- Fixed death screen on first softcore join; players now spawn directly at the beach.

### Research & Crafting
- Research tables can now be used to research Animal Fence and Gate.

### Farming & Food
- Milk can be stacked when the skim timer is under 1 minute, and skimming works even if food spoiling is disabled.

### Vehicles
- Scrap helicopter dismount points adjusted to avoid always ejecting players from the front.

2026-10-03.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.
